Life Journey App 
As people grow older, two significant and often interconnected challenges frequently emerge: social isolation 
caused by a lack of meaningful conversation, and hearing loss that can lead to frustration, embarrassment, 
depression, or withdrawal from social interaction when communication becomes difficult. For many older 
adults, daily interactions at home or in care facilities are often limited to routine tasks such as meals, 
medication, or physical assistance, with too few opportunities for deeper emotional connection and personal 
expression. At the same time, families often realize too late that the memories, wisdom, and life stories of their 
loved ones were never recorded, resulting in the permanent loss of valuable personal history and family 
heritage. Although many care providers aim to improve resident engagement and emotional well-being, there 
is still no simple, accessible digital solution specifically designed to preserve life stories, encourage meaningful 
conversation, and strengthen connections between older adults and their families.1 
The Problem 
As people age, two important problems often appear that are not well addressed by current 
technology or care systems: 
• Loneliness and Lack of Meaningful Conversation: Many older adults, even when living with family 
or in care homes, do not have regular meaningful conversations. Most daily interactions are functional 
(medication, food, appointments), not personal or emotional. 
 
• Life Stories, Memories, and Personal Legacy Are Often Left Unshared: Older adults hold a 
lifetime of stories, experiences, wisdom, values, lessons, and family history, but: 
o These stories are rarely recorded  
o Many older adults have valuable experiences and wisdom they wish to share beyond daily 
conversations  
o Families often don’t hear them in time  
o Older adults may lose the opportunity to feel seen, valued, and remembered through the 
impact of their life journey  
There is currently no simple digital tool focused specifically on life stories, emotional connection, and family 
interaction. 
  
 
1 About one in three (34%-37%) older adults aged 50–80 reported feeling isolated or lonely in 2023, a significant, 
persistent issue affecting health. Loneliness is linked to higher mortality, cognitive decline, and depression. Key causes 
include loss of loved ones, reduced mobility, hearing loss, and living alone. (Aging, 2024)

3 
Life Journey App 
The Solution 
Life Journey App is a voice-first life story and family connection platform designed specifically for older 
adults. 
It allows older adults to: 
• Talk about their life and memories  
• Record stories using voice (no typing required)  
• Automatically convert speech into organized stories using AI  
• Build a timeline of their life stories  
• Share stories with a private family circle or other allowed networks 
• Receive responses, reactions, and messages from others 
This creates a continuous emotional, creative, and social loop: 
AI Mentoring & Discovery → Story Sharing → AI Crafts Meaningful Stories → Private or Public 
Connection → Reactions & Shared Memories → Stories Grow Richer → User Feels Seen, Valued, and 
Remembered → New Chapters Begin 
This is not just a recording tool. 
This is a living platform for connection, recognition, identity, belonging, and legacy.

5

Market analysis 
Market Opportunity 
Several long-term trends support this product: 
• The population aged 65+ is growing rapidly  
• Loneliness and social isolation among older 
adults is increasing  
• Families often live far from parents  
• Voice technology and AI transcription are 
now mature and affordable  
• Families are willing to pay for memory 
preservation and meaningful connection  
This product sits at the intersection of: 
• Senior care  
• Family technology  
• Memory preservation  
• Voice AI applications  
Market size 
This market sizing shows a large global opportunity in senior care and memory-preservation technology, with 
165.9 million potential users across key developed markets. Our initial go-to-market strategy focuses on 
capturing a realistic early segment of 250,000 users within the highest-need target audience of seniors and 
their families.

7 
Life Journey App 
Business Model 
We operate a hybrid B2C + B2B SaaS model. Families subscribe monthly to preserve memories and stay 
connected with aging parents, while senior living communities license the platform to improve resident 
engagement, family satisfaction, and differentiated care experiences. 
This dual-channel strategy combines high-scale consumer growth with recurring institutional contracts, 
creating multiple revenue streams and efficient customer acquisition. 
Revenue Streams 
• Family Subscriptions ($9–$19/month)  
• Senior Care Facility Licenses (annual contracts / per resident pricing)  
• Premium Legacy Products (printed memory books, advanced plans)  
• Future Healthcare / Wellness Partnerships 
B2C – Families 
Subscription model: 
• Monthly or annual subscription per family  
• Includes:  
o Unlimited story recording  
o AI transcription and story organization  
o Private family access  
o Life timeline  
o Digital archive  
o Book export (premium feature)  
B2B – Care Homes 
License model: 
• Per resident per month, or  
• Facility license  
Care homes can offer this as a premium engagement and memory program for residents and families.

Life Journey App 
Competitor Analysis 
The memory-preservation market is validated, with players such as Storyworth, Remento, and LifeBio 
proving strong emotional demand. However, most competitors focus on one-time storytelling products 
rather than ongoing relationship platform. 
Competitor Focus Key Limitation 
Storyworth Weekly prompts + printed memoir book Text-first, low engagement after completion 
Remento Voice memories turned into stories/books Output-focused, not continuous companionship 
LifeBio Senior life stories for care settings Traditional model, limited AI-native experience 
GrandPad Family communication for seniors Hardware-focused, weak storytelling capability 
Market Gap 
Current solutions help families record memories, but few solve the broader need for: 
• Reducing loneliness  
• Meaningful ongoing conversation  
• Family collaboration around stories  
• Preserving identity over time

10 
Life Journey App 
Our Positioning 
We are building an AI Life Companion for older adults and families — combining voice conversation, memory 
capture, family connection, and legacy preservation in one platform. 
Competitive Advantage 
Our differentiation is not transcription or book creation. It is: 
• Continuous AI companionship  
• Personalized memory timeline that grows over time  
• Family participation and shared storytelling  
• Expansion into wellness, reminders, and caregiver insights  
 
Strategic Conclusion 
Competitors validate demand but remain narrow solutions. We aim to create the next category: a trusted AI 
relationship platform for aging adults and their families.
